settings.title: Settings
settings.host_helper: OpenSearch Dashboards answers on this host, Grafana under /grafana
settings.backend_helper: The bundled OpenSearch needs at least 4 GB of free RAM with its dashboards
settings.opensearch_heap_mb_helper: Java heap of the bundled OpenSearch; the container uses about the double
settings.admin_password_helper: Password of the 'admin' user of OpenSearch Dashboards, at least 10 characters
settings.retention_days_helper: Indices older than this are deleted; 0 keeps every report
settings.dashboards_enabled_tooltip: The parsedmarc dashboards are imported in the global tenant and in each tenant
settings.metrics_enabled_tooltip: DMARC counts per tenant and domain for the Prometheus of the NethServer metrics module, with alert rules and a Grafana dashboard. No password and no report detail leave this module. Needs NethServer core 3.24.0 or later
settings.cluster_metrics_detected_description: The DMARC dashboard and alerts of this instance are in the metrics module ({module}): the dashboard is in its Grafana, which is enabled in the metrics module settings. The bundled Grafana is not needed
settings.cluster_metrics_disabled_description: The metrics module is installed: enable the cluster metrics to see the DMARC dashboard and alerts in its Grafana
settings.cluster_metrics_missing_description: No metrics module in the cluster collects these metrics. Use OpenSearch Dashboards or the bundled Grafana
settings.grafana_not_needed_description: The cluster Grafana already shows the DMARC dashboard of this instance. Keep the bundled Grafana only for the upstream dashboard with report details
settings.grafana_enabled_tooltip: Grafana with the parsedmarc dashboard under /grafana, for the cluster administrators, with the OpenSearch report details. Not needed with the cluster metrics module: its Grafana shows the DMARC dashboard of this instance
settings.imap_ssl_tooltip: On for port 993; off for STARTTLS on port 143
settings.pick_mail_server: Pick a mail server of the cluster
settings.no_mail_servers: No mail server found in the cluster
settings.gmail_credentials_helper: Key of a service account with domain-wide delegation and the gmail.modify scope
settings.gmail_credentials_set: A key is stored; paste a new one to replace it
settings.delete_tooltip: Off: processed messages are moved to the archive folder
settings.watch_tooltip: Process new messages as they arrive (IMAP IDLE or polling); off: check at an interval
settings.save_failure_tooltip: Failure reports can contain message headers and bodies: personal data
settings.strip_attachment_payloads: Strip attachment payloads of failure reports
settings.nameservers_helper: Comma separated; empty uses the Cloudflare resolvers. IP, https:// (DoH) or tls:// (DoT)
settings.offline_tooltip: No DNS or geolocation query, no database download
settings.summary_email_description: After each run with new reports, send the results as a ZIP through the cluster smarthost
settings.outputs_description: Copies of every report besides the storage backend. GELF, Loki, Azure Log Analytics and PostgreSQL are configured in state/parsedmarc-extra.ini, see the README

tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.how_description: The reports of a tenant's domains go to indices prefixed with the tenant name. The tenant user logs in to OpenSearch Dashboards and sees only its own indices, in its own Dashboards tenant. A tenant mailbox stores every report it receives under the tenant prefix.
tenants.empty_description: Every report goes to the shared indices
tenants.name: Name
tenants.name_helper: Lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter; also the index prefix
tenants.name_invalid: Use 2 to 31 lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter
tenants.domains_helper: One per line, base domains only (subdomains are matched)
tenants.password_helper: Login of the tenant user (the tenant name) in OpenSearch Dashboards; empty: no login
tenants.own_mailbox_tooltip: A separate parsedmarc process reads this mailbox
tenants.remove_description: The tenant {name}, its Dashboards user and tenant are removed. Its indices are kept.

validation.domain_in_two_tenants: Domain already used by another tenant
